objective: Open the repository with a complete, editable mission blueprint; require explicit structure confirmation before preparing bounded Agent Team collaboration.
non_goals: Do not execute agents from the static browser interface.
Do not add graph cycles, dynamic expansion, hidden joins, or whole-graph retries.
Do not bind durable workstreams to named model vendors.

permission_boundary.rollback: Restore the last verified repository and blueprint checkpoint.

nodes.verifier: Mission objective, constraints, non-goals, and success criteria are complete.
nodes.idempotency: Pure repository intake produces the same normalized mission brief.
nodes.label: Mission intake
nodes.summary: Name the outcome, constraints, evidence, and permission boundary.

nodes.verifier: The editable graph contract passes bounded client checks and can be exported with a stable structure hash.
nodes.idempotency: Write the same versioned blueprint contract atomically.
nodes.compensation: Restore the previous versioned blueprint contract.
nodes.label: Design the blueprint
nodes.summary: Make topology, payloads, joins, budgets, owners, and recovery explicit.

nodes.verifier: The approval receipt hash matches the client-validated mission and graph structure.
nodes.idempotency: One receipt is valid only for one canonical structure hash.
nodes.compensation: Invalidate the receipt when any mission or graph field changes.
nodes.label: Confirm structure
nodes.summary: A human explicitly approves the exact validated structure before team allocation.

nodes.verifier: The strict validator exits zero for the exported graph contract and the receipt hash matches the confirmed structure hash.
nodes.idempotency: Emit at most one runtime validation receipt for one canonical structure hash.
nodes.compensation: Invalidate the receipt when the exported contract, command evidence, or confirmed hash changes.
nodes.label: Validate at runtime
nodes.summary: The execution harness validates the exact exported contract before recruiting any worker.

nodes.verifier: The candidate artifact and targeted interface checks pass inside the owned territory.
nodes.idempotency: Overwrite only the isolated implementation artifact for this contract hash.
nodes.label: Build in isolation
nodes.summary: A capability-routed builder produces one isolated implementation candidate.

nodes.verifier: Static DAG, typed edge, join, budget, writer, and MECE boundary checks pass.
nodes.idempotency: Review the same contract hash and replace only the reviewer receipt.
nodes.label: Review the contract
nodes.summary: An independent reviewer checks graph and architecture invariants.

nodes.verifier: Editable, persistence, import/export, accessibility, and responsive acceptance checks pass.
nodes.idempotency: Review the same candidate and replace only the experience receipt.
nodes.label: Review the experience
nodes.summary: An independent reviewer checks the human-facing blueprint workflow.

nodes.verifier: All declared workstream artifacts are fresh, compatible, accepted, and integrated in dependency order.
nodes.idempotency: Integrate one accepted artifact set for the confirmed contract hash.
nodes.label: Integrate serially
nodes.summary: The integration owner alone accepts and combines verified workstreams.

nodes.verifier: Every required command is fresh, the mission acceptance checks pass, and cleanup is recorded.
nodes.idempotency: Emit one terminal receipt for one integrated artifact hash and evidence set.
nodes.compensation: Invalidate the terminal receipt when evidence or implementation changes.
nodes.label: Verify before claim
nodes.summary: Fresh command evidence and mission-level acceptance prove completion.

edges.condition: receipt hash matches exported graph contract
strict validator exits zero and receipt hash matches
strict validator exits zero and receipt hash matches

joins.verifier: The implementation candidate and both independent review receipts share the confirmed contract hash.

stop_conditions: Any graph, node, team, or review budget is exhausted.
The same failure signature repeats after one changed attempt.
The structure confirmation receipt is missing or stale.

blueprint.summary: Confirm the whole structure first. Then allocate bounded, independently reviewable Agent Team workstreams.
success_criteria: The repository opens directly into an understandable mission blueprint.
Mission, graph, team, and presentation fields are editable without source-code changes.
Browser refresh preserves the local draft.
JSON import and export round-trip the complete blueprint.
A valid structure hash and explicit human receipt gate the team handoff.
Required repository checks and responsive browser acceptance pass.

admission.rationale: Allocation opens after human confirmation; worker recruitment waits for strict validation of the exact exported contract.
admission.orchestration_tax: Bounded by three workstreams, three isolated artifacts, one serial integration owner, and an 800-line review cap.

team_command.checkpoint_cadence: After each material artifact or decision.
team_command.interrupt_policy: Stop a workstream on ownership conflict, stale confirmation, repeated failure signature, permission denial, or budget exhaustion.
allowed_tools: Edit files inside the assigned territory.
denied_tools: Change the shared graph contract after confirmation.

workstreams.name: Editable blueprint builder
workstreams.capability: Accessible static-web implementation and state modeling
workstreams.verifier: Targeted model and browser interaction checks pass.
workstreams.stop_condition: Candidate passes or the bounded attempt budget is exhausted.

workstreams.name: Graph contract reviewer
workstreams.capability: Static DAG, typed payload, join, budget, and architecture-boundary review
workstreams.verifier: Strict graph validation and MECE boundary review pass.
workstreams.stop_condition: Review accepts, rejects with evidence, or exhausts its budget.

workstreams.name: Experience and accessibility reviewer
workstreams.capability: Keyboard, persistence, import/export, responsive, and safety review
workstreams.verifier: The browser acceptance matrix passes with no blocking accessibility issue.
workstreams.stop_condition: Review accepts, rejects with evidence, or exhausts its budget.

integration.verifier: The integration owner accepts one fresh artifact at a time, then runs the full repository checks.
integration.rollback: Restore the pre-integration checkpoint and reject only the incompatible artifact.
